items.item: `Sources/Xcode Scheme/Xcode.Scheme+Write.swift`: the scheme name is interpolated into a file
items.reason: The file is now Sources/Xcode Scheme/Xcode.Scheme.swift; write(_:to:) already builds the file name with File.Path.Component("\(name).xcscheme"), which throws .containsPathSeparator for '/' (and NUL), mapped to Xcode.Scheme.Error.path before any directory is created. Added the missing regression test (names '../../escaped' and 'nested/scheme' throw .path).

notes: Test-only commit; no source change needed.
